msContents.summary: Artzneybuch: von allerley künnstlich betwerten unnd nützlichen Recepten für mancherley züfelligen krannckheiten zusammen gebracht. Including a translation of `De passionibus mulierum' of Trotula by Silvester Hartlieb, and an abbreviated version of Ortolff von Baylerland's `Srtzneibuch', extracts from Albertus Magnus, and medical receipts, etc. On fol. 221 is a pen-drawn fortune-telling circular diagram. The first 21 ll. are unnumbered; these are followed by a foliation from I to 250 which is irregular; the last 28 ll. are not numbered. The original foliation is used for the list of contents which follows. On the veso of the last leaf is an inscription of three lines in capitals: Omnes: Gentes: Tres: Castes: Pates: Erfares: Hafursta: Pallustra: Genefrat: Bedi. [li]Starting on third preliminary leaf: "Klagrede der Ertzney / an stat einer vorrede / Johann Betz.", 10 leaves, followed by Indexes and wine receipts.[/li][li]Starting on 21st and last preliminary leaf: "Trotvla. / Buech von haimlich / kait der weiber und an /dre Künstliche Artzney ze alerley /Schwachayt des leyes. Verdeutschit / durch den weyrberümpternn hoch gelertenn hernn // doctor Siluester Hartlieb.", Fol. 52 "Seliglichen volenndt / durch den Schreiber zuuorderst genennt // Aldi[ngae?] denn 25 Marcii / Anno L ii [1552]."[/li][li]Ff. 53-78 Miscellaneous medical recipts.[/li][li]Fol. 78 Nun volgett gründttlicher unnd eygenttlicher / Berichtt der gantzen Menschlichen gesundtt / heytt wie mann dieselbigenn behaltenn / unnd wann man sie verleust wider / bekommenn soll., etc. This is an abbreviated version of Ortolff von Bayer land's `Arzneibuch' beginning `Salomon spricht der ewige gott in der propheceye'. 144, line 6 End (Chapter on `Erperkraut').[/li][li]Fol. 144, line 7 Incipiunt dicta magistri Alberti gloriosissimi Doctoris.[/li][li]Ff. 150-233 Miscellaneous medical receipts for plague and other diseases, with a few household receipts., 224-225v `Baldt ordnung' for the Duchess of Württemberg, dated Strassburg [15]68., 225, 227v `Historia morbi Petri Schers uxoris à Schwartzenberg', `Consilium F[o]scheri pro eadem': Signed `Fischer zu Diebing'., 227v-235 Other `Consilia' including one `Pro Domino Abbate Bernhardo Coenobii Altorff' (fol. 230v), and a `Baad ordnung pro comitissa de Sulz' (fol. 232). Also a letter ending `anno [15]70 mense Martio Joh Guinth, And. prescripsit'. (Johann Guinther von Andernach [1487-1574].), 235-238v Miscellaneous medical receipts., 238v-end Extracts and receipts from Paracelsus and Fallopius, and miscellaneous medical receipts and remedies.[/li]

history.provenance: There are copious underlinings in red and blue pencil, marginal notes, etc. in purple ink by `Karl [Theodor] Messmer Chemiker' whose signature, dated 1880 at Immenstadt, appears on the first leaf. His library-stamp and a stamp containing his name and a crest have been impressed in several places throughout the book.
